issues.detail: The Greek 'εις δοξαν θεου' indicates a destination or purpose ('into/unto the glory of God'), whereas the Vietnamese 'để sự vinh hiển của Đức Chúa Trời được tỏ ra' translates it as a resultative clause ('so that the glory... may be revealed'). The Greek implies being received *into* glory, not just for the sake of a revelation.
